bear.reason: set from the market's own pricing of the downside state: declining information-services businesses trade near six times cash earnings (observed range roughly five to eight) and keep only a fraction of their margins through a real decline. This cell takes the most charitable coherent reading - cash-margin retention of the closest surviving decliner, and a multiple at the top of the observed range in credit to the balance sheet (margin stated on the operating line; equivalent to roughly 16.3% on the cash-earnings line - the closest surviving decliner's margin retention applied in full). The company's own trading record contains no downside-state precedent (it opens in 2017, inside the growth era), so the cross-section governs. [amended 2026-07-22]

base.reason: the base describes a stabilized business that no longer grows, and multiples must be paired to the state they describe. The stabilized state's observable prices sit far below the growth era: the highest-quality stabilized peer trades near 12.5 times cash earnings, a distrusted-but-stable data business near 6.5, and a comparable data company was taken private near 8. The prior 15.0x was set 'deliberately below' the company's own long-run median - but that median comes from a trading record that opens in 2017, entirely inside the growth era: the same window defect the downside leg carried. At 12.5x the base still prices the whole business near a 7% cash-earnings yield - fair for excellent-and-stable, generous for anything less. [amended 2026-07-22]

bull.reason: The turn proves cyclical: FY27E re-acceleration (+4%); margin near the FY2023 best (20.94%); the multiple moves toward but stays below the median of its own trading history. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

verdict.rationale: BUY at $141.06, 6.7:1 against the 2:1 bar; a brutal secular bear still clears 2.0. The market is pricing GenAI as a structural displacement of syndicated research; our judgment is that the sell-off has overshot fair value for a still-intact business — five straight years of 18–21% operating margins, absolute EBITDA rising through the decline, ~11% trailing free-cash-flow yield, an entry near the 3rd percentile of its own nine-year multiple range. Only the top line has slowed. The trade fails if revenue never re-stabilizes — a shrinking Gartner deserving ~12x — with contract-value growth at the August print as the first test. [amended 2026-07-22: with the perimeter-corrected D&A the deep-stress case — base revenue -20% (~$5,144M) at a 13% margin and an 8x exit — reads ~1.90:1 against the 2.0 bar (was 2.02); the formal bear leg clears at ~5.8:1.] [amended 2026-07-22: position closed 2026-07-21 at 141.06 - the entry price, flat before costs - by operator action immediately after entry. The re-underwrite completed 2026-07-22 set the downside from market evidence and no coherent grid clears the 2:1 bar, confirming the exit; the record moves to watch. The August 5 report is still read; it informs re-engagement, not this exit.]
reunderwrite_triggers: price below about $125 - computed from the recorded grid as the level where reward reaches twice the risk - re-run at the live price

the quarterly report shows contract-value growth stabilizing AND client count, salesforce and retention turning - re-set the downside case from the new evidence and re-underwrite in full. Recorded quarterly baselines for that reading: quota-bearing headcount 4,866 (-3.4%); client enterprises 12,913 (from 13,600); trailing-twelve-month new contract value increase $54M (-83.8%); wallet retention 96.5% technology / 98.3% business / 97.7% global; consulting backlog $200.5M (-8.6%), billable headcount 875 (-9.6%).
verdict.avoid_priced_note: position closed flat at the entry price on 2026-07-21 by operator action, before this analysis existed. Under the revised grid no evidence-coherent reading clears the 2.0 bar at that price - about 1.3 to 1 on the most charitable cells, far below 1 on the central ones. Disclosure: under the previously recorded base multiple (15.0x, amended above with reasons), the charitable downside alone would have read 2.03 to 1 - a knife-edge inside the boundary band, flipped by one step on any cell. The base revision is load-bearing; its reasons stand independent of the exit.
